A young '''[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girl''' lived on the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] her [[Planet/Legends|planet]], she survived the slaughter carried out against many of her people, and took up residence with [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] and his [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|freedom fighters]] in their [[Twi'lek freedom fighters hideout/Legends|hideout]]. After the forces of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] broke the blockade of the planet and successfully landed ground forces on the surface of Ryloth, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] sought out the Twi'lek freedom fighters and their leader, Cham Syndulla in hopes of convincing them to aid their plans to liberate their planet. After being escorted to their hideout in the ruins of [[Cazne/Legends|Cazne]], this girl enthusiastically greeted Syndulla with a hug. After retaking the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] and reclaiming Ryloth for the Twi'lek people, the girl participated in a parade to celebrate the Twi'lek and Republic victory.<ref name="LoR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Twi'lek girl's only appearance has been in the twenty-first episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] television series.<ref name="LoR" />
